title: Gradients by hand
subject: Machine learning
summary: Work out gradients on paper before letting a framework do it, so that when training misbehaves you can tell what the numbers are doing.

objectives.title: Apply the chain rule to a composed function
Derive the gradient of a two-layer network by hand

projects.title: A two-layer network, by hand and in code
projects.brief: Pick a small dataset. Work one forward and backward pass through a two-layer network on paper, with real numbers. Then write the same pass in code and check the two agree to the digit. Say where they first disagreed, if they did.

criteria.criterion: Derives the backward pass on paper before writing any code, and the working is legible.
Shows the hand figures and the code figures side by side, and says where they differ.
States the shape of every matrix at every step, and the shapes are right.
